nodes.text: @lisekimhorton Wait til kids are dying of preventable diseases, crippled by polio, & bird flu jumps to humans for a new pandemic w vaxx research. blocked. I am getting knee surgery done asap before the nutsos take over completely.

nodes.author: lisekimhorton
nodes.text: @KittieRein19308 Bird Flu has already jumped to humans.

nodes.author: KittieRein19308
nodes.text: @lisekimhorton not at epidemic levels yet. It’s quite frightening that wild waterfowl, which are abundant around me, spread the disease.

nodes.author: lisekimhorton
nodes.text: @KittieRein19308 And the massive spread to cattle, and cats are also becoming ill. The 1918 flu began as a zoonotic virus before it jumped to humans.

nodes.author: KittieRein19308
nodes.text: @lisekimhorton and now raw milk & possibly eggs. I don’t think the current flu vax is effective either. I hope Tяump doesn’t dismantle pandemic monitoring systems that Elon says will save money. It’s appalling.
